item.title: 012 The Architecture of Meaning Environments. The Vitruvian Triad of Sovereign Thinking
item.description: Construction creates objects. Architecture designs the environments in which those objects become possible. This article marks the final stage of Core Recalibration and introduces the architecture of meaning environments as a sovereign systems-thinking discipline.
